parameters.subject: ={{ $json.emailContext === 'rfe' ? '[URGENT-RFE] Additional Documents Required — Case ' + $json.caseId : $json.emailContext === 'rework' ? '[Rework Required] Resubmit Documents — Case ' + $json.caseId : '[Action Required] Document Submission — Case ' + $json.caseId }}
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json['Employee_Name'] }},

Your visa case has been opened and a lawyer has been assigned.

Case ID    : {{ $json['Case_ID'] }}
Visa Type  : {{ $json['Visa_Type'] }}
Deadline   : {{ $json['Filing_Deadline'] }}
Lawyer     : {{ $json['Assigned_Lawyer_Email'] }}

Please submit the following documents within 5 business days:
  1. Passport (all pages)
  2. I-94 / Status Document
  3. Educational Certificates
  4. Offer Letter
  5. Previous Visa Copies
  6. Signed Declaration Form

Upload Here: [Google Drive Link]

HR Immigration Team

parameters.subject: =[ESCALATION] Employee Unresponsive — Case {{ $json['Case_ID'] }}
=[REMINDER {{ $json['Reminder_Count'] }}/3] Documents Pending — Case {{ $json['Case_ID'] }}
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json['Employee_Name'] }},

This is Reminder #{{ $json['Reminder_Count'] }} regarding 
your pending visa documents for Case {{ $json['Case_ID'] }}.

Visa Type       : {{ $json['Visa_Type'] }}
Filing Deadline : {{ $json['Filing_Deadline'] }}

Required Documents:
  1. Passport (all pages)
  2. I-94 / Status Document
  3. Educational Certificates
  4. Offer Letter
  5. Previous Visa Copies
  6. Signed Declaration Form

Upload Here: [Google Drive Link]

HR Immigration Team

parameters.subject: =[Review Needed] {{ $json['Visa_Type'] }} Docs Ready — Case {{ $json['Case_ID'] }}
=[GO - FILE NOW] {{ $json['Visa_Type'] }} Petition — Case {{ $json['Case_ID'] }}
=[Filed] Your {{ $('IF - Docs Complete').item.json['Visa_Type'] }} Petition Submitted — Case {{ $('IF - Docs Complete').item.json['Case_ID'] }}
=🎉 [APPROVED] Your {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Visa_Type'] }} Visa — Case {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Case_ID'] }}
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Employee_Name'] }},

Congratulations! Your {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Visa_Type'] }} 
petition has been APPROVED by USCIS.

Case ID  : {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Case_ID'] }}
Deadline : {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Filing_Deadline'] }}

Your I-797 Approval Notice will be mailed to address on file.

Next Steps:
  - HR will coordinate visa stamping if required
  - Keep your approval notice safe at all times
  - Work authorization valid per dates on notice

HR Immigration Team

parameters.subject: =[Next Steps] Post-Approval Checklist — Case {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Case_ID'] }}
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Employee_Name'] }},

Now that your visa is approved, please action the following:

  ✅ I-797 Approval Notice (keep original safe)
  ✅ Updated I-9 Form (bring originals to HR)
  ✅ Passport Stamp if consular processing needed
  ✅ Travel Authorization Letter if applicable

Please visit HR within 3 business days with originals.

HR Immigration Team

parameters.subject: =[Important] Regarding Your {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Visa_Type'] }} Case — {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Case_ID'] }}
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Employee_Name'] }},

We regret to inform you that USCIS has not approved 
your {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Visa_Type'] }} petition.

Your HR team and legal counsel will contact you within 
1-2 business days to discuss options including:
  - Motion to Reopen (MTR)
  - Appeal options
  - Alternative visa pathways

Please do not make international travel plans until 
further notice.

HR Immigration Team

parameters.subject: =[URGENT] Visa Rejected — {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Employee_Name'] }} | Case {{ $('Match Case for Decision').item.json['Case_ID'] }}

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.item.json;

return {
  json: {
    Case_ID:               (d['Case_ID']               || '').toString().trim(),
    Employee_Name:         (d['Employee_Name']         || '').toString().trim(),
    Employee_Email:        (d['Employee_Email']        || '').toString().trim(),
    Manager_Email:         (d['Manager_Email']         || '').toString().trim(),
    HR_Email:              (d['HR_Email']               || '').toString().trim(),
    Assigned_Lawyer_Email: (d['Assigned_Lawyer_Email'] || '').toString().trim(),
    Visa_Type:             (d['Visa_Type']              || '').toString().trim(),
    Priority:              (d['Priority']               || 'Normal').toString().trim(),
    Filing_Deadline:       (d['Filing_Deadline']       || '').toString().trim(),
    Documents_Submitted:   'no',
    Docs_Complete:         'no',
    USCIS_Decision:        (d['USCIS_Decision']        || 'Pending').toString().trim(),
    RFE_Due_Date:          (d['RFE_Due_Date']          || '').toString().trim(),
    Reminder_Count:        parseInt(d['Reminder_Count'] || '0'),
    Rework_Count:          parseInt(d['Rework_Count']   || '0') + 1,
    Status:                'REWORK_REQUESTED',
    emailContext:          'rework'
  }
};
